# Citation verification log (generated by tools/build_refs.py)

Title, authors, year and arXiv ID come from the arXiv API (queried 2026-10-04) and are authoritative. 'Venue' is filled only where the venue page or listing was seen in-session; every other entry is cited as an arXiv preprint and **its published venue must be checked before submission**. Classics (DiT/ICCV 2023, LDM/CVPR 2022, ADM/NeurIPS 2021, FID/NeurIPS 2017, rectified flow/ICLR 2023, DeepSeekMoE/ACL 2024) are believed to be published but were not re-verified.

**Deliberately NOT cited (unverified):** 'DIET' (not found by any search), 'OLED-MoE' (not confirmed by name; an arXiv ID quoted by an AI reviewer was never verified), 'TimeAware MoE (IEEE)'. Do not add them without locating the source.
